definitions.gloss: to rephrase; to say again; to correct oneself
definitions.explanation: to say something again in different words, or to correct what one has said

examples.japanese: ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{言|い}い⟦{直|なお}した→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I misspoke so I corrected myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧{言|い}い⟦{直|なお}して→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく{言|い}い{直|なお}す⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦こういう→こういう：21476_kouiu⟧ことだ。
examples.english: To put it more simply, this is what it means.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)

COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + {直|なお}す (to redo/fix)
The {直|なお}す adds the meaning of doing again or correcting.

USAGE:
- {言|い}い⟦{直|なお}して→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please say it again/rephrase it)
- {言|い}い{直|なお}す⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (to put it differently)
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{間違|まちが}え→間違う：03036_machigau⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{直|なお}す (to correct a slip of the tongue)

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}す→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧ (to rewrite)
- ⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧ (to redo)
- ⟦{作|つく}り{直|なお}す→作り直す：20924_tsukurinaosu⟧ (to remake)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}い{換|か}える→言い換える：04595_iikaeru⟧ (to rephrase, paraphrase)
- ⟦{訂正|ていせい}する→訂正する：10443_teiseisuru⟧ (to correct)
- ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧ (to revise)
